output.title: BR-15 a CHF invoice cannot be finalised while no exchange rate exists on or before its invoice date @critical
output.data_choice: P-1090 is billed to Alpine Precision AG in CHF, and the only seeded CHF rate takes effect from 2026-11-01, after the 2026-10-31 invoice date. So no rate is effective on or before the invoice date. Its single approved, billable 6-hour architect entry gives one predictable line.
